expressions.title: The North-West Frontier Province Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Act, 1975
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 1574556-1574557 print 'ACT No. XXXVII OF 1975 / An Act to provide for measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion and to regulate movement of vehicular traffic within the limits of Municipal Committee, Peshawar'; s.1(1) (block 1574562) names it the North-West Frontier Province Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Act, 1975; complete to s.13 and the signature on p3 (blocks 1574594-1574596) and the imprint. Blocks 1574549-1574555 (p1) are the tail (ss.2-3) of an Act amending the N.W.F.P. Public Service Commission Act, 1973 that began before this PDF -- a fragment, set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
